text:
kevin: Hey team — first day stuff :) I'm blocked on accessing the rdx shared Drive. After signing in via Okta I get 'account not in organization' when I open drive.redwood.ai. Also Okta keeps prompting for device enrollment and loops when I try to complete. I haven't received a 1Password invite either. Who should I ping for a quick reprovision?

emily-it: @kevin — welcome! Sorry for the hassle. Quick checks: do you have any alternate email aliases (personal/work) in your Google account? sometimes the GDrive mapping goes to the alias. Also which browser/os?

kevin: macOS Ventura, Chrome stable. No alternate emails I know of. Tried the same in Safari incognito, same error. Okta shows me as "Provisioned" but Device Trust shows "Unenrolled" and the enroll flow fails after the 'Install MDM profile' step.

jonas: Did you get a Jamf/os-level prompt to allow profile install? On mac we usually need to open System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Allow Jamf profile. If it never shows, try Settings -> Profiles and remove any partial RDW profile then retry enroll.

kevin: I don't see any RDW profile. When I hit enroll, the browser shows a long spinner then this small error modal: `Enrollment failed: 403 - org mismatch`

emily-it: OK that 403 helps. Two things: 1) I just checked the Okta admin console — your user has a stray alias with your personal gmail (kevin.personal@gmail.com) listed under email aliases. That can cause Google mapping to pick the wrong org. 2) I'm re-sending you a 1Password invite from the correct org now.

helpdesk-bot: Ticket created: IT-4821 — "New hire kevin: Okta device enroll loop + Google Drive org mismatch". Assigned to emily-it. ETA 2 business hours.

jonas: If you want to try a quick local workaround while we fix the alias, open an incognito window and sign into drive.redwood.ai using the "Use another account" button and explicitly enter your work email (kevin@redwood.ai). That bypasses the browser-saved account list. Also try `chrome://settings/clearBrowserData` -> Cached images and files (don't clear passwords).

kevin: Tried incognito and explicitly typed kevin@redwood.ai — still get the same 'account not in organization' on the Drive page, but Okta auth itself succeeds. I'm happy to wait for the alias fix. Thanks for sending the 1Password invite.

emily-it: Invite should land within a few minutes. For the device enroll loop, I'm going to reset your device trust flag in Okta (remote wipe the partial enrollment) and re-trigger the flow. I'll post here when done.

emily-it: Done — I cleared the partial enroll and removed the gmail alias from your profile. Re-run the enroll flow and accept the macOS profile prompt when it appears. Also check the 1Password invite in the spam folder if you don't see it.

kevin: OK re-ran the enroll, the profile prompt appeared and I allowed it. Device shows as Enrolled in Okta now. Drive opened successfully — I can see the rdx shared drive. 1Password invite just came through and I completed setup. All good on my end :thumbsup: Thanks everyone!

jonas: Awesome — welcome aboard :) If anything else pops up ping #new-hires or @emily-it directly.

kevin: Thanks! I'll close the ticket once I confirm access to all team folders.
